literal.description: Search for pattern as plain text.

total_hits.description: Matches found before the result was cut; absent when the scan stopped at a limit and never counted the rest. Do not treat a missing value as zero.

at_limit_cap.description: True when the hit limit stopped the scan.

lines_truncated.description: True when a match or context line was shortened to the per-line cap.

context_omitted.description: True when context lines were dropped to fit the token budget.
